activeSlice.scope: Add read-only ephemeral real-public-Brand contexts to the certified Hunter V2 shadow evidence runner so rollout evidence can satisfy the existing >=3 distinct Brand requirement without persisting test Brands, weakening Brand readiness, or changing Hunter production authority.
successCriteria: At least one persisted Hunter-ready production Brand remains part of the evidence cohort.
Ephemeral Brands represent distinct real public Brands and are derived from fetched public evidence plus the existing Brand Brain proposal validator.
Ephemeral Brand Brain must pass the unchanged canonical createBrandBrainActivationSnapshot hunterReady gate; no readiness override or synthetic ready flag is allowed.
Ephemeral Brand contexts are never inserted into Brands, Brand Brain, source, opportunity, feedback, or learning tables.
V1 and V2 receive the exact same ephemeral Brand context and paired input fingerprint.
The operational cohort reaches at least 3 distinct Brands and 30 paired runs without canary or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
